name: ZheJiang HuaSheng Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: ZheJiang HuaSheng Technology Co.,Ltd is a Chinese company focused on the creation, production, and distribution of both airtight and PVC flexible materials. Their offerings in airtight materials encompass specialized PVC for inflatable boats and drop stitch fabrics. Furthermore, their PVC flexible material line includes products like PVC flex banners and PVC tarpaulins. This enterprise is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.
